title: Recording: Another Day by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Studio B, CBS Studio Building, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Tim Geelan, Ted Brosnan

Paul McCartney recorded ‘Another Day’, his debut solo single, on 12 October 1970.

Great song. I remember doing many tracks of overdubbed guitar parts. I thought it was a magical song and production.
David Spinozza
Urbl Remedy

The recording took place in Studio B at the Columbia Records studios at 49 East 52nd Street, New York City. Additional overdubs were taped in January the following year at the city’s A&R Studios.

McCartney produced the sessions himself, with CBS’s in-house engineer Tim Geelan manning the mixing desk and Ted Brosnan the tape operator.

McCartney brought a number of songs to the sessions, which initially took place with Linda, guitarist David Spinozza and drummer Denny Seiwell. “He’d strap on a guitar or piano and start playing and singing a tune and we’d learn the tune and start recording,” Seiwell recalled. “We just did a tune a day.”

That song just blew my mind when I heard him singing and playing it on an acoustic guitar. As a studio man, you sometimes have to do what we call ‘polishing a turd’ – people bring in songs that aren’t really great songs, but obviously, your job is to make them great songs. When he started playing ‘Another Day’, and it went into the section in three – where it changes time signatures – on the first listen through, you knew you were in for a real treat. This was not another job, this was gonna be really special.
Denny Seiwell, 9 June 2016
The McCartney Legacy: Volume 1: 1969-73, Allan Kozinn, Adrian Sinclair

McCartney played his Martin D-28 acoustic guitar during the session. The multitracks had McCartney and Spinozza on guitar, recorded on separate tracks, and Seiwell’s drum kit spread across three tracks.

‘Another Day’ was recorded between 9am and 5pm. With the basic tracks completed, McCartney and Spinozza overdubbed electric guitar parts, and Seiwell added more snare and bass drums.

After 5pm McCartney added a bass guitar part, working alone. The song was completed with six vocal tracks recorded on 21 January 1971.

‘Another Day’ was one of a relatively small number of McCartney solo recordings to be mixed in mono, which included the Ram album.
